# NHANES 2009–2010 MMRV assay-era sensitivity source

Official codebook: https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2009/DataFiles/MMRV_F.htm

The downloaded MMRV_F and DEMO_F public-use XPT files contain 5652 laboratory-linked records; the age 6–14 domain contains 1715 records and 1715 positive examination-weight records. Non-missing laboratory results in the age domain are {'LBXMEA': 1386, 'LBXMUM': 1386, 'LBXRUB': 1386}. The cycle uses Wampole ELISA, while the active NHANES 2017–March 2020 layer uses a multiplex bead assay. These files therefore remain a separate assay-era sensitivity source; they are excluded from the primary pooled serological estimate.
